add_locations.name: jo9_seed_role_images
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START EGEYA_STALE_ROLE_IMAGES_20261022
! Global cleanup and non-mutating read resolver; keep actor cache markers across ONGLOAD -> JSON.
local $jo9_seed_role_stem, $jo9_seed_role_keys, $jo9_seed_role_dirs, $jo9_seed_role_old, $jo9_seed_role_wanted, $jo9_seed_role_new
local jo9_seed_role_id, jo9_seed_role_k, jo9_seed_role_known
$jo9_seed_role_stem[0]='medico'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[1]='por'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[2]='kirakira'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[3]='tsuina'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[4]='yammy'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[5]='antenna'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[6]='alyce'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[7]='mist'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[8]='joker'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[9]='Inui'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[10]='zion'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[11]='rin'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[12]='kikuchiyo'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[13]='Ririe'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[14]='Kyoka'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[15]='Noelle'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[16]='Miruki'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[17]='Tamaki'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[18]='Chiharu'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[19]='Fumi'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[20]='Sana'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[21]='Nanami'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[22]='Shuko'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[23]='celestine'
$jo9_seed_role_stem[24]='olga'
$jo9_seed_role_keys[0]='fullmade'
$jo9_seed_role_keys[1]='fullsecretary'
$jo9_seed_role_keys[2]='fullmistress'
$jo9_seed_role_keys[3]='fullpregnant'
$jo9_seed_role_dirs[0]='maid'
$jo9_seed_role_dirs[1]='secretary'
$jo9_seed_role_dirs[2]='mistress'
$jo9_seed_role_dirs[3]='pregnant'
if $args[0]='resolve':
 $result=$args[2]
 jo9_seed_role_id=args[1]
 $jo9_seed_role_wanted=$args[3]
 if jo9_seed_role_id>=2577 and jo9_seed_role_id<=2601:
  for jo9_seed_role_k=0 to 3:
   jo9_seed_role_known=1
   if jo9_seed_role_k=3 and (jo9_seed_role_id=2585 or jo9_seed_role_id=2597 or jo9_seed_role_id=2600 or jo9_seed_role_id=2601): jo9_seed_role_known=0
   if jo9_seed_role_known=1:
    $jo9_seed_role_old='girls/full/'+$jo9_seed_role_dirs[jo9_seed_role_k]+'/'+$jo9_seed_role_stem[jo9_seed_role_id-2577]
    if $args[2]=$jo9_seed_role_old:
     $result=$fullimage[jo9_seed_role_id]
     if $jo9_seed_role_wanted='fullmade' or $jo9_seed_role_wanted='fullsecretary' or $jo9_seed_role_wanted='fullmistress' or $jo9_seed_role_wanted='fullpregnant':
      $jo9_seed_role_new=dyneval('$result = $<<$jo9_seed_role_wanted>>[jo9_seed_role_id]')
      if $jo9_seed_role_new ! '': $result=$jo9_seed_role_new
     end
     exit
    end
   end
  end
 end
 exit
end
! Original25 role values are absent/empty. Four absent legacy pregnancy keys are never inferred.
for jo9_seed_role_id=2577 to 2601:
 for jo9_seed_role_k=0 to 3:
  jo9_seed_role_known=1
  if jo9_seed_role_k=3 and (jo9_seed_role_id=2585 or jo9_seed_role_id=2597 or jo9_seed_role_id=2600 or jo9_seed_role_id=2601): jo9_seed_role_known=0
  if jo9_seed_role_known=1:
   $jo9_seed_role_old='girls/full/'+$jo9_seed_role_dirs[jo9_seed_role_k]+'/'+$jo9_seed_role_stem[jo9_seed_role_id-2577]
   dynamic "if $<<$jo9_seed_role_keys[jo9_seed_role_k]>>[jo9_seed_role_id]=$jo9_seed_role_old: $<<$jo9_seed_role_keys[jo9_seed_role_k]>>[jo9_seed_role_id]=''"
  end
 end
end
! JO9 MOD END EGEYA_STALE_ROLE_IMAGES_20261022
